key.name: first-day-of-week
key.summary: First day of the week: 0=Monday … 6=Sunday

key.name: litsycal-toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to show/hide the calendar

key.name: beep-on-hour
key.summary: Play a sound on the hour

key.name: hour-sound-file
key.summary: Custom sound file path for the hourly beep
key.description: Empty string means use the system theme's default bell sound.

key.name: disabled-calendars
key.summary: UIDs of calendar sources hidden from the grid and agenda

key.name: last-event-calendar-uid
key.summary: Internal: calendar UID last picked when creating a new event
key.description: Set automatically whenever a new event is saved; used as the New Event form's default calendar next time. Not user-facing.

key.name: agenda-days
key.summary: How many days ahead the agenda covers: 0 hides it, otherwise 1-7, 14, or 31

key.name: prefs-initial-page
key.summary: Internal: which Preferences tab to show next time the window opens
key.description: Set by the settings menu right before it opens the Preferences window; not user-facing.

key.name: show-week-numbers
key.summary: Show an ISO week-number gutter beside the calendar grid

key.name: timezones
key.summary: IANA time zone ids for the live clocks shown above the footer
key.description: Empty list hides that section. Example: ["America/New_York", "Europe/Lisbon"].

key.name: home-timezone
key.summary: IANA time zone id used as the reference point for relative offset labels next to each configured time zone
key.description: Empty string disables offset labels. Set manually in Preferences, or via "Detect my location" (uses GNOME's location service).

key.name: extra-week-rows
key.summary: Extra overflow weeks shown below the current month, via the resize handle

key.name: show-event-dots
key.summary: Show event dots on day cells in the grid

key.name: show-event-location
key.summary: Show each event's location in the agenda list

key.name: show-empty-agenda-days
key.summary: Show every day in the agenda range, including ones with no events

key.name: dot-color-mode
key.summary: Event dot colour: per-calendar colour or monochrome

key.name: badge-style
key.summary: Panel badge style
key.description: One of: number-light, number-dark, calendar, calendar-dark, text, logo

key.name: calendar-band-color-mode
key.summary: Colour of the top band on the calendar badge styles
key.description: custom uses calendar-band-color; the accent modes follow the system accent colour

key.name: calendar-band-color
key.summary: Custom calendar badge band colour (hex)

key.name: show-month-in-badge
key.summary: Show abbreviated month in the badge

key.name: show-dow-in-badge
key.summary: Show day-of-week abbreviation in the badge

key.name: hide-icon
key.summary: Hide the panel badge entirely

key.name: show-countdown-in-badge
key.summary: Show a countdown to today's next meeting in the badge
key.description: Shows a countdown (e.g. "5m", "now") next to a meeting icon whenever today has an upcoming or in-progress joinable meeting. See countdown-badge-mode for whether it replaces or joins the normal badge text.

key.name: countdown-badge-mode
key.summary: Whether the meeting countdown replaces or joins the normal badge text

key.name: datetime-pattern
key.summary: Custom strftime pattern for the badge (overrides other badge settings)

key.name: show-time
key.summary: Show time in the panel badge

key.name: time-format
key.summary: Time format for the panel badge: 24h or 12h

key.name: calendar-size
key.summary: Calendar size: 0=S, 1=S+, 2=M, 3=M+, 4=L

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Calendar text size: 0=S, 1=M, 2=L

key.name: highlight-days
key.summary: Day abbreviations whose columns are highlighted (mo tu we th fr sa su)

key.name: short-day-names
key.summary: Show single-letter weekday headers instead of three-letter abbreviations

key.name: theme
key.summary: Colour theme: system, light, or dark

key.name: weekend-color-mode
key.summary: Weekend day colour mode: default, none, or custom

key.name: weekend-color
key.summary: Custom weekend day colour (hex)

key.name: calendar-system
key.summary: Year numbering shown in the calendar: gregorian or buddhist (Gregorian + 543)
